resolved.rationale: Reviewer B claims: Missing nil checks for optional fields (High Severity)

Reviewer B claims: IPv6 address handling improvements (Medium Severity)
Reviewer B claims: Description: Added proper handling for nil IPv6 addresses, primary flags, and device indexes. This prevents crashes when IPv6 fields are not populated.
Reviewer B claims: Test coverage for nil optional fields (Low Severity)
Reviewer B claims: Description: Added comprehensive test cases covering all scenarios where optional fields may be nil. This ensures the nil handling works as expected.

Reviewer B claims: The changes modify label behavior when fields are nil - previously some labels would be empty strings, now they are omitted entirely. This could affect dashboards or alerts that expect certain labels to always be present.
Reviewer B claims: The additional nil checks add minimal overhead but could impact performance at very large scale. However, this is justified by the stability improvements.
Reviewer B claims: The debug logging for missing availability zone IDs (lines 400+) could generate more log messages in environments where this is common.
